audit.whatIsWrong: The page rates this 8.5/10 'Hard matchup' with a red tone while the packet reports Illaoi at 53.99% over 776 games, and every whys row from level 3 on says Illaoi wins.
audit.why: Difficulty and the level chart were telling opposite stories. I fixed the chart, which is unambiguous, and left the difficulty tokens alone rather than guess at the intended scale.
audit.corrected: Chart rows corrected to the packet; diff/diffRating left for the user to decide (see questionsForUser).

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill, Olaf, Olaf, Skill, Skill, Olaf, Olaf. The packet says Olaf, Olaf, then Illaoi for all five remaining rows.
audit.why: Olaf's Undertow slow and Reckless Swing own levels 1-2; from level 3 Test of Spirit pulls his soul and the tentacle wall denies his escape, which is exactly what whys[2..6] already say. Only row 1 was right.
audit.corrected: phases[0]/win[0] to Olaf; phases[2,3,4,5,6] and win[2,3,4,5,6] to Illaoi, all as matched pairs, with the 4/10 ratings on the now-Illaoi rows 3 and 4 raised to 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Olaf's W was called 'Vicious Strikes' in four places and credited with his lifesteal.
audit.why: Riot's kit: W is Tough It Out — increased attack speed and a shield, 16/15/14/13/12s. The lifesteal comes from the passive, Berserker Rage, scaling with missing health. So anti-heal matters more the lower he gets, and his W is a burst-absorbing shield, not a sustain button. Reckless Swing (E) deals true damage to him and to you.
audit.corrected: Renamed to Tough It Out throughout, moved the lifesteal to Berserker Rage, and stated Undertow's flat 9s cooldown and Ragnarok's 80s late cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The advice is 'build armor' while Olaf's main damage button is true damage.
audit.why: The _missing feed flags exactly this (resistances-invalidated): Reckless Swing ignores armour and MR, so stacking armour does not answer his burst — health, sustain and Grievous Wounds do. Armour still helps against his autos, so the fix is emphasis, not a reversal.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text now says armour does nothing against Reckless Swing and to buy health instead.

audit.why: Undertow is a flat 9s but resets when Olaf picks the axe up, so the real punish is denying the pickup — already covered, now with the number.

edits.before: This is your swing point: once E Test of Spirit is up you pull his soul and the real Olaf can't run through the tentacle wall. Olaf wants to E Reckless Swing and W Vicious Strikes to lifesteal-brawl, so only commit W Harsh Lesson when his axe (Q Undertow) is on cooldown and he can't slow-kite you.
edits.after: This is your swing point: once Test of Spirit (E) is up you pull his soul and the real Olaf cannot run through the tentacle wall. He brawls with Reckless Swing (E) true damage and Tough It Out (W) attack speed plus a shield, so commit W (Harsh Lesson) only when Undertow is down — 9s at every rank.

edits.before: With bruiser items and stacked tentacles you out-sustain and out-damage Olaf in a straight slugfest. His axe pickup gives him movespeed, so fight in tight spots where he can't retrieve Undertow to kite.
edits.after: With bruiser items and stacked tentacles you out-sustain Olaf in a straight slugfest, but Reckless Swing is true damage — armour does nothing against it, so buy health, not pure armour. Deny the axe pickup to stop his kite.

edits.before: Olaf falls off relative to your scaling; a full tentacle field shreds him even through Vicious Strikes healing. Keep vision — his R makes him a strong flanker/diver, so don't get caught out of position without your tentacles.
edits.after: Olaf falls off relative to your scaling; a full tentacle field shreds him even through Berserker Rage lifesteal, which ramps as he drops low — keep Grievous Wounds up. Ragnarok is 80s late and makes him a diver, so never fight without tentacles.

edits.before: With items and full tentacle stacks you out-sustain and out-damage his Vicious Strikes brawl; his R makes him CC-immune so rely on tentacle damage, not your R knock, and stay warded against his dives.
edits.after: With items and full tentacle stacks you out-sustain and out-damage his Tough It Out (W) brawl; Ragnarok makes him immune to disables while he keeps attacking, so win on tentacle damage, not displacement.

edits.before: Through 4-5 your stacked tentacle damage beats his Vicious Strikes sustain.
edits.after: Through 4-5 your stacked tentacle damage beats his Berserker Rage sustain.

edits.before: Reckless Swing / Vicious Strikes brawl before your E
edits.after: Reckless Swing / Tough It Out brawl before your E

notes: Fabricated/legacy ability name 'Vicious Strikes' for Olaf's W removed in four places — the real ability is Tough It Out (attack speed + shield); his lifesteal is the passive Berserker Rage. Left diff FAV / 8.5-out-of-10 / red tone untouched because they conflict with a 53.99% win rate and with the corrected chart — see questionsForUser. tldr and winCon still say 'build armor' against a true-damage E; I did not rewrite them because armour is still correct against his autos, but the emphasis now lives in spikes[2].text.
